Full job description 

We are seeking a highly skilled Solution Architect with proven expertise in Ezy-Serve, Change-Ezy SaaS and SAP solutions. The ideal candidate must have led end-to-end implementation of Ezy-Serve SaaS solution with integration to SAP S/4 HANA. Web Application, mobile application development, architecture, and deployment in Field Service Mobility Solutions. This role requires extensive customer engagement, technical solutioning, and ongoing support to ensure seamless adoption and optimization of the SaaS platform. 

Key Responsibilities: 

Architect, develop, and optimize the Ezy-Serve, Service Delivery platform and Ezy-Day mobile applications for iOS and Android. 

Own the full software lifecycle from conceptualization to go-live for Ezy-Serve mobility solutions. 

Drive the next-gen evolution of Ezy-Serve and Ezy-Day, enhancing performance, security, and scalability. 

Ensure seamless backend integration of Ezy-Day and the Ezy-Serve platform using RESTful services with SAP S/4 HANA, SAP GEF and integration with ESRI ArcGIS. 

Provide technical leadership to a team of developers, mentoring them on mobile app best practices. 

Drive implementation of SAP GEF on S/4 HANA integration with ESRI ArcGIS. 

Develop offline-capable mobile applications with advanced GIS integrations, including ESRI, SAP GEF, Mapbox, and OpenStreetMap. 

Act as a primary liaison for enterprise customers, ensuring successful implementation, troubleshooting, and support. 

Conduct customer engagement workshops to gather requirements, provide demonstrations, and ensure seamless onboarding of SaaS solutions. 

Collaborate with customer IT teams to align Ezy-Serve SaaS solutions with existing enterprise applications. 

Monitor and support customer deployments, ensuring high availability, proactive issue resolution, and continual improvements. 

Spearhead mobile app security using authentication, encryption, and data protection best practices. 

Manage the scalability and performance optimization of Ezy-Serve and mobility solutions for large enterprise customers. 

 

 

Mandatory Requirements: 

Hands-on experience in Ezy-Serve and Change-Ezy SaaS products, with multiple deployments. 

Proficiency in Android (Java), iOS (Swift), Angular WebApplication, and Restful Integration for enterprise field mobility applications. 

Strong experience in GIS mapping solutions within Ezy-Serve, S/4 HANA, Ezy-Day and ESRI ArcGIS. 

Expertise in Spring Boot, REST APIs, Kafka, PostgreSQL, and microservices architecture.

About Dipole Group
We are a wholly Australian owned and operated ICT and Telecom networks specialist delivery business. Dipole operates locally, regionally, and internationally. Our capabilities span across Telecommunications, Finance, Insurance, health, Public Services, Print / Digital Media, Broadcast and Supply Chain. Dipole Group is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

The Role

We are seeking an experienced AI & Data Architect to lead the design, architecture, and delivery of enterprise-scale Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, and Data Platform solutions.
This role is responsible for defining the enterprise AI and data architecture, establishing governance frameworks, and designing scalable, secure, and production-ready AI solutions. The successful candidate will bridge Data Architecture, AI Engineering, Data Science, Machine Learning, and Enterprise Architecture, ensuring AI capabilities are aligned with business strategy while remaining flexible and independent of any single technology vendor.

The environment includes AWS Bedrock, Snowflake Cortex, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), modern data platforms, and enterprise foundation models including Anthropic Claude.

The successful candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, enterprise architects, data engineers, AI engineers, security teams, and cloud architects to build enterprise AI capabilities that are secure, governed, scalable, and future-ready.

Key ResponsibilitiesAI & Enterprise Architecture

Define the enterprise AI strategy and target architecture.
Design scalable AI and data platforms supporting enterprise-wide AI adoption.
Develop AI reference architectures, standards, and architectural principles.
Ensure AI solutions align with enterprise architecture, security, governance, and business objectives.
Design vendor-agnostic AI architectures to avoid dependency on a single LLM or cloud provider.
Lead AI solution architecture reviews and technology selection.
Data Architecture

Design modern enterprise data architectures supporting AI and advanced analytics.
Develop enterprise semantic data models and knowledge architectures.
Design scalable data ingestion, transformation, and integration frameworks.
Define data governance, metadata management, master data management, and data quality standards.
Architect data lake, data warehouse, and lakehouse solutions.
Ensure enterprise data platforms support AI, analytics, and business intelligence.
AI Governance & Responsible AI

Define AI governance frameworks.
Establish AI safety guardrails and responsible AI policies.
Design evaluation frameworks for AI quality, hallucination detection, and model performance.
Define governance for prompt management, model lifecycle management, and AI observability.
Ensure compliance with regulatory, security, privacy, and enterprise governance requirements.
Cloud & Platform Architecture

Design cloud-native AI platforms on AWS and Snowflake.
Architect scalable, resilient, and secure AI workloads.
Define Infrastructure as Code and automation standards.
Design API-first architectures for AI services.
Support enterprise integration using event-driven and microservices architectures.

Next Steps
If you are passionate about AI & Data Engineering and have the necessary skills and experience, please click on the APPLY button now. Due to the high number of applicants, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for further discussion within 3-5 business days. We thank you for taking an interest in this opportunity with us.

Job Type: Full-time, Permanent

Salary: From 120,000 AUD per annum plus Superannuation.

result.description:
We are looking for an experienced and strategic Cyber Security Architect to lead the design and implementation of advanced security systems across enterprise environments. This role is responsible for developing security architecture frameworks, identifying cyber risks, and delivering secure-by-design solutions that align with business goals and compliance standards.
The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in security controls, cloud security, enterprise infrastructure, and governance frameworks, and will play a lead role in defining the organisation’s cyber defence strategy.
Key Responsibilities:
Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-wide security architecture covering infrastructure, applications, data, identity, and cloud platforms.
Lead security assessments, threat modelling, and risk analysis during the solution design phase for new systems or services.
Define and implement security reference architectures and ensure adherence to frameworks such as NIST, ISO 27001, CIS Controls, and Zero Trust.
Oversee the integration of security tools and controls across network, endpoint, identity, and cloud layers (e.g., SIEM, EDR, CASB, IAM, firewalls).
Collaborate with software engineers, DevOps teams, and cloud architects to embed security-by-design principles in SDLC and CI/CD pipelines.
Review security incidents and recommend architectural enhancements to improve resilience and reduce attack surfaces.
Develop and maintain policies, procedures, and architectural documentation, ensuring alignment with internal governance and external regulatory requirements.
Act as a key stakeholder in incident response planning, disaster recovery architecture, and business continuity strategies.
Provide technical guidance and leadership to security engineering and operations teams, and advise executives on cyber risks.
Liaise with vendors, regulators, and third parties to ensure security architecture is compliant and up to date with emerging threats.
Required Qualifications & Skills:
Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in Cyber Security, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related discipline.
5+ years of experience in cyber security with at least 2–3 years in security architecture or design roles.
Strong understanding of network security, encryption, identity management, cloud security (AWS/Azure/GCP), and endpoint protection.
Proficiency with security technologies such as SIEM, IDS/IPS, IAM, MFA, EDR, firewalls, VPNs, and vulnerability scanners.
Hands-on experience designing secure systems in cloud-native, hybrid, or on-premise environments.
Strong knowledge of cybersecurity standards and frameworks (e.g., NIST, ISO 27001, ASD Essential Eight, OWASP).
Excellent documentation, stakeholder engagement, and risk communication skills.
Desirable:
Relevant certifications such as SABSA, CISSP, CISM, AWS Security, Azure Security Engineer, TOGAF.
Experience in Zero Trust Architecture, DevSecOps, or secure multi-cloud environments.
Background in regulated industries such as finance, healthcare, critical infrastructure, or government.
Familiarity with threat intelligence platforms, security automation, and SOAR tools.

Permanent Residents (PR) and Australian Citizens are eligible to apply
Job Type: Full-time
Salary: $70,000 to $120,000 per year + Super

MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Job Description:

Help Redesign the Future of Healthcare in Australia

Shape One of Australia's Largest Healthcare Transformations-Join the team delivering Bringing Care Home, St Vincent's bold vision to care for 50% of patients and residents through virtual and in-home settings by 2030. This is an opportunity to influence how healthcare is delivered across Australia for generations to come.

Lead at the Intersection of Cloud, AI and Digital Health-Design and architect a next-generation ecosystem spanning patient and clinician applications, remote patient monitoring, AI-enabled services, cloud-native platforms, and enterprise healthcare integrations.

Build Something New, Not Maintain the Past-This is not a BAU architecture role. You will help establish the technical foundations, standards, and future-state architecture for a nationally significant transformation program from the ground up.

About Bringing Care Home

For more than 160 years, St Vincent's has delivered care where it is needed most.

Today, we're doing it again.

Bringing Care Home is our enterprise-wide transformation to deliver more connected, personalised and accessible healthcare through virtual care, remote patient monitoring, digital health technologies and innovative models of care.

This is more than a technology transformation - it's a transformation of healthcare itself.

The Opportunity- Lead Solutions Architect - Bringing Care Home Transformation 

This is a permanent full-time position with flexible hybrid working arrangements available across Sydney, Melbourne or Brisbane.

Reporting initially to the National Director, Architecture & Portfolio Management, and transitioning into the Bringing Care Home leadership structure as the program matures, you will serve as the technical authority responsible for shaping the architecture that underpins one of Australia's most significant healthcare transformation programs.

Working at the intersection of cloud, AI, digital health and virtual care, you will provide architecture leadership across a complex ecosystem of patient and clinician applications, remote patient monitoring platforms, enterprise integrations, healthcare data services and emerging technologies. Partnering closely with executives, clinicians, product teams, architects, engineers and delivery partners, you will ensure technology decisions are scalable, secure, future-focused and aligned to exceptional patient outcomes.

You will lead the design and technical direction of:

Patient and clinician-facing mobile applications

Cloud-native digital healthcare platforms

Remote patient monitoring solutions

Enterprise integration services

AI-enabled healthcare capabilities

Secure healthcare data ecosystems

Modern DevSecOps and delivery practices

Working across executives, clinicians, product teams, engineers, architects, and delivery partners, you will ensure technology decisions support exceptional patient outcomes while remaining scalable, secure, and aligned to enterprise standards.

How You'll Make an Impact

Success in this role will see you:

Establish the architecture foundations that enable scalable virtual and in-home healthcare services nationally

Deliver solution architectures across key digital, cloud, integration, data and AI initiatives

Create reusable design patterns, standards and governance frameworks that accelerate future delivery

Drive alignment across multiple delivery partners, platforms and technology workstreams

Champion modern engineering practices - cloud-native architecture, DevSecOps, automation, and AI-enabled solutions - applying them hands-on, not just as guiding principles

Provide trusted technical leadership to executives, clinicians and technology teams

Contribute to positioning St Vincent's as a leader in digitally enabled healthcare innovation

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership

Provide architecture leadership across a complex multi-partner environment, ensuring solutions are secure, scalable and fit for purpose.

Solution Architecture

Lead end-to-end architecture across applications, cloud, integration, data, AI and clinical technology domains.

Innovation & Modern Engineering

Champion and personally apply cloud-native architectures, automation, AI-enabled capabilities, and contemporary software delivery practices. This includes hands-on involvement in spikes, proof-of-concepts, and design validation - not solely governance and oversight.

Governance & Risk

Provide design assurance, architectural governance and proactive risk management across major initiatives.

Stakeholder Engagement

Translate complex technical concepts into meaningful business outcomes for executives, clinicians, vendors and delivery teams.

About You

You are an experienced Technical Architect with a strong engineering background - you have come up through platform engineering, software engineering, or cloud engineering, and you still get hands-on. You have a proven track record delivering complex digital transformation programs within enterprise environments, and you have been actively building and shipping cloud-native and AI-enabled solutions in the last two years - not just advising on them.

You will bring:

7+ years' experience within large-scale technology environments, including at least 3 years in a Technical or Solution Architect role - and critically, hands-on technical implementation experience in cloud and AI within the last 2 years. Candidates who have moved fully away from hands-on delivery will not be the right fit for this role

Demonstrated, recent hands-on experience (within the last 2 years) designing and delivering enterprise-grade solutions across AWS and-or Azure cloud environments

Mandatory: Deep, hands-on expertise in cloud-native architecture - API-led integration, event-driven platforms, enterprise data architecture, containerised and serverless technologies, and modern DevSecOps and CI-CD practices. You have built and shipped these patterns, not just designed them on whiteboards

Experience designing customer, patient, clinician or employee-facing digital products, including mobile and web-based applications

Proven capability delivering architecture across multiple domains including applications, integration, cloud, data and security

Mandatory: Demonstrated hands-on experience designing and implementing AI-enabled applications using modern AI services (Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, LLM APIs, conversational AI, agentic workflows) - you have built with these tools, not just recommended them

An engineering mindset: you are comfortable doing technical spikes, validating integration approaches hands-on, reviewing code and infrastructure, and working alongside engineers to unblock delivery - architecture for you is a doing discipline, not just a thinking one

Ability to provide technical leadership and influence stakeholders across business, clinical, product and technology teams within complex delivery environments

Highly Regarded

Data Engineer (also known as BI Developer, Quantitative Data Engineer, Search Engineer, Technical Architect, Big Data Analyst, Solutions Architect, Data Warehouse Engineer, Data Science Software Engineer, ETL Developer)
The role of the Data Engineer is to work alongside solution architects, data analysts & data scientists to deliver various aspects of the marketing technology ecosystem. The Data Engineer is responsible for engaging machine learning techniques to create and sustain structures that allow for the analysis of data whilst remaining familiar with dominant programming and deployment strategies. Data engineering experience is critical, as well as knowledge of data warehousing, ETL strategies and tools, and BI tools. Experience in cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS and GCP is beneficial.
Data Engineer Responsibilities:
•	Anticipating and mitigating delivery risks and following issues through to closure
•	Advocating for data management methodologies and processes on all projects
•	Assuming responsibility for data quality, ensuring that testing is carried out in a rigorous fashion resulting in production of high-quality deliverables
•	Adopting a flexible approach to completing workload to ensuring timely delivery and reinforcing commitment to delivery and quality within the technical team, including offshore development centres 
•	Creating and managing the relevant technical design documentation and ensures the documents completeness and accuracy
•	Ensuring that data architecture is implemented according to the design 
•	Ensuring solutions delivered use existing standards and frameworks
•	Contributing to business development efforts through accurate project scoping, estimating and attending sales calls when required
•	Collaborating with globally dispersed teams on international projects.  This includes co-ordinating build activities with offshore development centres in India and Asia Pacific
•	Remaining up-to-date with industry standards and technological advancements that will improve the quality of your outputs.
Data Engineer Requirements:
•	All of the above roles require a relevant tertiary qualification or a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in lieu of qualification.
•	Proven experience as a data engineer, software developer, or similar.
•	Expert proficiency in Python, C++, Java, R, and SQL.
•	Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
•	Works well independently but also a team player and able to work collaboratively
•	Scrupulous approach to duties.
•	Strong presentation and written communication skills, with ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical colleagues and clients
•	Experience developing data processing and analytics solutions in a digital agency or IT consultancy as part of a multi-disciplinary team

Solution Architect  
   
 PERSOL is one of Australia's largest and longest serving recruitment providers. Delivering both quality temporary and permanent options, we specialise in the recruitment of Professional, ICT, Government, STEM, Management and Executive talent. 
 Our client is looking for an experienced Solution Architect to join a high-performing team delivering complex and innovative software solutions within a large-scale industrial and technology environment. 
   
 Roster:                  Monday-Friday Perth based 
 Start date:           ASAP 
 Duration:             approx. 12 months - depending on client requirements 
 Pay Rate:              $110.00 p/h + Super depending on experience 
   
  Please note that only people with relevant experience will be considered and contacted.  
   
  The Role:   
 This position plays a critical role in bridging business requirements and technical implementation, ensuring solutions are scalable, efficient and aligned with broader product strategies and architectural standards. 
 Working closely with Product Owners, Software Architects, Systems Engineers, Development Teams and QA, you will be responsible for designing solutions that extend and enhance existing systems while supporting seamless integration across multiple technologies and platforms. 
   
  Key responsibilities include but are not limited to:     
 
 Develop solution designs aligned with established architecture frameworks, product standards and high-level system designs. 
 Translate business and product requirements into detailed technical solutions and implementation plans. 
 Break solution designs into clear and actionable work packages for software delivery teams. 
 Define system dependencies and interface requirements to ensure successful integration across multiple components and systems. 
 Ensure all solution designs comply with functional safety and engineering requirements. 
 Analyse existing systems and identify opportunities for enhancement, optimisation and standardisation. 
 Provide technical guidance and design support throughout the development lifecycle. 
 Define API and third-party integration methods in accordance with established standards. 
 Select and recommend appropriate technologies and frameworks for efficient implementation. 
 Produce and maintain architecture documentation, including system diagrams, component interactions and data flows. 
 
  Required Experience:   
 
 Extensive experience designing and delivering complex software solutions. 
 Strong understanding of software engineering principles and best practices. 
 Proven experience with systems integration, APIs and interface design. 
 Experience translating high-level requirements into detailed technical designs. 
 Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities. 
 Excellent communication skills with the ability to engage technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 Experience working within Agile or product-based delivery environments. 
 Exposure to work package creation and project delivery methodologies. 
 
  Highly Regarded:   
 
 Experience within mining, industrial technology, autonomous systems, robotics, defence or heavy industry environments. 
 Exposure to functional safety standards and requirements. 
 Experience working across multidisciplinary engineering and software teams. 
 
   
  If you are interested in the role and fit the criteria, please apply online today! If you have any further questions before applying online, please email Holly Storor at    holly.storor@persolapac.com   
     
  **PLEASE NOTE - only applicants with recent experience will be considered**  
   

  Who we are  
 At  PERSOL , we connect people to meaningful work and growth. With decades of experience and a future-focused mindset, we're here to support your career journey. We offer fresh opportunities, trusted guidance, and a people-first approach. 
 We're committed to creating a safe, inclusive, and respectful workplace that embraces diverse experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We strongly encourage applications from women, people of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander descent, and individuals from all communities.
